options.text_en: Two rooks line up to checkmate the enemy king

options.text_cn: 后在对角线将死被己方棋子封住的王
options.text_en: A queen checkmates a king trapped by its own pieces along a diagonal

options.text_cn: 车和马配合，将死困在角落或边格的王
options.text_en: A rook and knight work together to checkmate a king trapped in a corner or on the edge

options.text_cn: 马跳将军，王被己方棋子封死
options.text_en: A knight gives check while the king's own pieces block its escape squares

explanation_cn: 阿拉伯杀是车和马的经典配合：车控制一条线（横线或竖线），马封住王的逃格，将死困在角落的王。这是国际象棋历史上最古老的将杀模式之一。
explanation_en: Arabian mate is a classic rook-and-knight pattern. The rook controls a rank or file while the knight covers the king's escape squares, checkmating a king trapped near the corner. It is one of the oldest known mating patterns in chess.
